race.comment: PRAY FOR ELEGANCE (9) gets some blinkers on now resuming. He took on a better maiden at Geelong and was favourite in that race. Has to be better for that experience and from the draw won't have to go as far back. Looks tough to beat. SEE NO CITY (3) had a few things go wrong last time when expecting to make some improvement. Has run some decent races and worth including in wider plays. PALMENTO (8) went to town for his first run and was fair in a tough race. Gelded before this outing and may show more here. MUDDY (10) went better second time around. Could easily do that again in what is not a strong race.
